resources.string: Invitation authorization is missing, expired, revoked, or could not be checked online. Gateway stopped. Redeem a valid invitation, select its node, and check your network before reconnecting.
Redeem a code to add a server subscription. Your built-in filter rules and current connection are not changed. Select an imported server on the home screen to connect.
Added %1$d servers to %2$s. Update this subscription to receive future node changes.
The invitation service is not configured correctly in this app. Contact your service provider.
Enter a code with 8–128 letters, digits or hyphens.
The invitation or subscription is invalid, expired, revoked, or fully used. Contact your operator.
Too many requests. Wait a minute before retrying.
Cannot reach the invitation service. Check your network and retry. The same code can safely retry an interrupted redemption.
The service returned an invalid subscription or no supported nodes. Existing nodes and filter rules were not replaced.
Cannot save the subscription. Free device storage and retry with the same code.
